@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: Put the span of an INVALID_FILTER error in extensions
+---
+## Request
+
+KanbanViewKit asks for this. Now, a `tasks(filter:)` call with a bad filter gives `INVALID_FILTER`, and the place of the error is only in the message text (`at N..M: …`). The kit filter field parses that text to underline the error. The error must also carry the span as numbers in `extensions`, so that the kit can stop parsing the message.
+
+Expected `extensions`: `{ "code": "INVALID_FILTER", "start": N, "end": M }`. The message text does not change.
+
+## Unit of the span
+
+- `start` and `end` count Swift `Character`s (extended grapheme clusters) from the start of the filter text. This is the unit of `KanbanError.invalidFilter(position: Range<Int>)` and of the message now (`FilterSyntaxError.kanbanError(in:)`, `Filter/FilterSyntaxError.swift:99`).
+- `end` is exclusive. The span is the half-open range `start..<end`.
+- Write the unit and the exclusive end in the doc comments, in the schema description of the error if one exists, and in divergence.md.
+
+## Design
+
+The engine cannot do this alone. `CodedError` (FoundationModelsExtras, `Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/GraphQL/CodedError.swift`) has only `code` and `message`, and `GraphQLError.coded(as:)` puts only `code` into `extensions`.
+
+- [ ] FoundationModelsExtras (`../FoundationModelsExtras`): add a requirement to `CodedError` for more `extensions` keys of an error (for example `var extensionFields: [String: Map] { get }`). Give it a default implementation that returns no key, so that each current error does not change. Merge the keys in `coded(as:)`. `code` must always win over a key with the same name. Make `CodedErrorJSON` carry the same keys, or record why it does not need them. Add tests in FoundationModelsExtras. Commit and push FoundationModelsExtras to its main.
+- [ ] Update the FoundationModelsExtras pin in `Package.resolved` to the new commit. If `swift package update` fails (it failed on swift-case-paths before), change the pin by hand, as for ^5yygn91.
+- [ ] FoundationModelsKanban: in `KanbanError` (`GraphQL/Errors.swift`), give `start` and `end` for `.invalidFilter`. Name the keys with constants. `FILTER_MODEL_MISSING` holds an `INVALID_FILTER` error of the text (`filterModelMissing(filterError:)`), so give it the same span keys. Look at each other case that holds a filter error, and do the same where it applies.
+- [ ] Tests in FoundationModelsKanban: a `tasks(filter:)` call with a bad filter gives the full error JSON with `code`, `start`, and `end`. Add a filter with a character that is more than one UTF-16 unit (for example an emoji before the error), to show that the unit is characters. Add a test for the `FILTER_MODEL_MISSING` span. Compare full responses.
+- [ ] divergence.md: record the new `extensions` keys, the unit, and the exclusive end. Do not edit plan.md.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- `INVALID_FILTER` errors have `extensions.start` and `extensions.end` as numbers. The message text is the same as before.
+- Errors with no span do not change.
+- The full test suites of both packages are green, with no new warnings.
+#kanbanviewkit
\ No newline at end of file
